body: Search infrastructure for AI applications that stores and retrieves embeddings and documents.
plain_description: **Search your business’s documents and data by meaning, keywords, or both.** Chroma stores and indexes information so your applications can find relevant results quickly. Add documents with automatic or custom embeddings, then search and filter them.
technical_description: Chroma is open-source data infrastructure for AI, providing vector, hybrid, and full-text search. Its Python and JavaScript clients support creating collections, adding documents and metadata, and querying similar results. It can run in memory for prototyping, persist data locally, or be used in client-server mode; Chroma Cloud offers hosted serverless search.
title: Chroma
